description_en: Awesome React Native components, news, tools, and learning material!
readme_excerpt: Awesome React Native is a curated list of the best libraries, tools, and learning resources for building React Native apps today. Every entry is checked for maintenance and relevance — if it's here, it works with modern React Native. PRs are welcome, see contributing. Contents - Getting Started - AI-Assisted Development - Agents & Skills - MCP Servers - On-Device AI - AI App Builders - Components - UI - Lists - Navigation - Sheets, Menus & Toasts - Forms & Keyboard - Text & Rich Content - Image…
